purpose: Derived temporal/provenance-aware semantic graph plus conservative bounded activation over exact FRANK/RAE state anchors; never a replacement for canonical exact truth or external authority.

layers.role: Stable references to authoritative events/records/state roots and versions; stores identity/provenance pointers, not a second authority.
Versioned typed assertions, relations, provenance, conflict sets, temporal validity and causal/evidence ancestry.
Cue/query/current-frame driven bounded activation with explicit reasons, freshness and conflict-preserving assembly.

identity.semantic_node_id: stable hash(versioned semantic kind + external identity)
identity.semantic_assertion_id: stable hash(subject semantic id + predicate semantics id + object/value semantic normalization + assertion scope)
identity.exact_anchor_id: store_id + record/table identity + source revision/version witness; content hash where safe

assertion_envelope.rule: Conflicting or differently attributed assertions may coexist; provenance/stance is never erased by last-write-wins.

exact_anchor_contract.rule: Current telemetry, capability/authority decisions, transaction commits, CognitiveFrame validity and migration parity require an exact authoritative read/witness; semantic activation cannot substitute for it.

seed_modes.vector: optional feature-gated candidate; must be benchmarked independently

activation_policy.weak_edge_rule: MENTIONS/RELATED/BELONGS_TO_BRANCH and broad dependency links do not expand by default without target lexical/vector support or explicit query intent.
activation_policy.freshness: Apply staleness/valid-time filters before ranking where the query has a current-time requirement; never convert freshness into evidence strength.
activation_policy.conflicts: Return incompatible active alternatives as a conflict_set with separate provenance/status rather than averaging/collapsing.
activation_policy.decay: bounded per hop; learned weights are future work and may not override evidence class/status

maintenance.change_input: authoritative event/changefeed or read-only diff; never infer writes from activation
maintenance.delta_frontier: update only semantically affected nodes/assertions when dependency closure is complete/conservative
maintenance.rebuild_fallback: full deterministic rebuild when closure is unknown, revocation/supersession fanout exceeds measured crossover, schema semantics change, or integrity check fails

retrieval_pipeline: classify query requirements: current exact | historical exact | semantic associative | mixed
seed lexical/exact-id and optional vector candidates
preserve conflict sets and evidence ancestry
fetch exact anchors for claims requiring current/exact validation
render model projection with activation reason and provenance

frank_mapping.M.DURABLE_EVENT_STATE: source of exact anchors/changefeed; remains authoritative
frank_mapping.M.COGNITIVE_FRAME_ASSEMBLER: provides current frame scope/version witnesses; does not accept graph activation as exact frame truth
frank_mapping.M.WORKSPACE_ARBITER: may receive memory candidates derived from validated active assemblies; selection semantics remain GWT-owned
frank_mapping.M.GOAL_GOVERNOR: may use graph relations as proposal evidence only
frank_mapping.M.CAPABILITY_GATEWAY: remains external hard authority boundary; capability refs are opaque/non-secret

migration_policy.preferred_pattern: exact/event stores -> versioned semantic projections -> transient activation assemblies
migration_policy.split_brain_rule: For migrated semantic memories, authoritative write lands in an event/exact contract first or atomically with a durable receipt; derived graph update may lag but must expose lag/staleness.

hard_invariants: graph/model output never mints capability/effect authority
exact CognitiveFrame/current-state validation bypasses associative approximation
secrets never become graph text/vector tokens

evidence_boundary.current_support: Architecture candidate supported by RAE branch convergence, current FRANK source and external standards/implementation literature.
evidence_boundary.self_use_proxy: Five-query local engineering proxy favors conservative qualified one-hop activation over parent-like two-hop and lexical baseline on recall/precision, but graph/gold are small and hand-anchored.
